candidates.change_summary: Replace the constructor argument for EmergencyOracle to set the owner to the contract's jojoTeam instead of msg.sender, causing the created oracle's owner (and thus who can call setAssetPrice/turnOn/off) to differ; newEmergencyOracle state (the address returned) remains the same but caller permission effects differ and will be observable via subsequent calls.
Emit the event using jojoTeam as the owner instead of msg.sender, changing the externally observable event contents that follow creation.

After creating the new EmergencyOracle, immediately transfer the jojoTeam state variable to the newOracle address, changing future onlyJojoTeam checks and thereby altering who can create subsequent oracles (observable externally).
Change the created EmergencyOracle to be constructed with address(0) as owner, making the oracle ownerless and changing who can later modify its price/state (observable externally).

Relax the onlyJojoTeam modifier to accept either jojoTeam or the contract owner (msg.sender == jojoTeam || msg.sender == address(this)), changing who can call newEmergencyOracle and thus which caller appears in the emitted event/newOracle creator behavior.
